grammar_focus: 动词/形容词 + 介词搭配(verb + to/at/for/with,复习 KS22)主考——belong/occur/confine to、astonished/surprised/arrive at、account/pay/wait for、agree/cope/satisfied with;so…that、admit + doing、be ordered to do / be confined to、a number of(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 当一架来自伦敦的飞机抵达悉尼机场时,工人们开始卸下装有服装的一批木箱。其中有只箱子特别重,谁也弄不清是怎么回事。突然,一个工人想到打开这只箱子看看。看到的情景使他大吃一惊——箱内有一个人正躺在一堆羊毛织品之上。他由于被人发现而感到非常吃惊,甚至都没有企图逃跑。此人被捕后,承认是在飞机离开伦敦前躲进箱里的。他经历了一次漫长而又难受的旅程,因为他在那木箱里闷了18个多小时。此人被责令交付旅费3500英镑,而正常票价才2000英镑!

grammar_card.title: 动词 + 介词:to / at / for / with 各有搭配
grammar_card.intro: 很多动词或形容词后面要跟固定的介词,换了介词意思就变。记住常见搭配:属于/想到/关在用 to;对…惊讶/到达/看用 at;说明/付款/等待用 for;同意/应付/满意用 with。全用本课句子举例。

rows: belong to / occur to / confine to
It occurred to him.(他想到) / confined to the box(关在箱里)
astonished at / surprised at / arrive at
astonished at what he found(对所见吃惊)
account for / pay for / wait for
account for the fact(说明) / pay for the trip(付旅费)
agree with / cope with / satisfied with
I agree with you.(同意) / cope with it(应付)
admitted hiding in the box(承认藏箱里)

specialRules.rule: 同一个动词换介词意思会变:see Tom(看见汤姆)≠ see to the dinner(负责做饭)。
admit / finish / enjoy 等后面接动名词:admitted hiding(承认藏)、finished eating(吃完)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What did the man in this story do?
options: He hid in a wooden box to travel from London to Sydney for free

passage: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport, workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing. No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy. It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box. He was astonished at what he found. A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods. He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away. After he was arrested, the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London. He had had a long and uncomfortable trip, for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours. The man was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip. The normal price of a ticket is £2,000!

stage5.stem: "This box ___ one of the passengers."(belong 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这箱子属于其中一位乘客。

stage5.stem: "It suddenly occurred ___ a worker that the box was too heavy."(occur 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一个工人突然想到这箱子太重了。

stage5.stem: "The man was confined ___ the wooden box for 18 hours."(confine 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这人被关在木箱里18个小时。

stage5.stem: "He was astonished ___ what he found."(astonished 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他对所看到的感到惊讶。

stage5.stem: "He was so surprised ___ being discovered that he didn't run."(surprised 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他对被发现感到非常吃惊。

stage5.stem: "The plane arrived ___ Sydney airport."(arrive 到达某地点用哪个介词)
"No one could account ___ the fact that the box was so heavy."(account 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 谁也说不清箱子为何这么重。

stage5.stem: "The man was ordered to pay £3,500 ___ the cost of the trip."(pay 为某事付款用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 此人被责令支付3500英镑旅费。

stage5.stem: "She had to wait ___ him at the airport."(wait 后面用哪个介词)
"I don't agree ___ you."(agree 后面用哪个介词)
"Poor Mary has so much to cope ___."(cope 后面用哪个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 可怜的玛丽有太多要应付。

stage5.stem: "I'm not satisfied ___ your work."(satisfied 后面用哪个介词)
"He was ___ surprised at being discovered that he did not run away."(…得…以至于,后接形容词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他被发现时太吃惊了,以至于没逃跑。

stage5.stem: "It was ___ a heavy box that no one could lift it."(…得…以至于,后接 a+名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 那箱子太重了,没人搬得动。

stage5.stem: "The man admitted ___ in the box before the plane left."(admit 后面接动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这人承认在飞机起飞前藏进了箱子。

stage5.stem: "He admitted ___ the money."(admit 后面接动名词)
"The man ___ to pay £3,500."(被命令做某事,用被动 be + 过去分词)
"Workers unloaded ___ wooden boxes."(许多,后接可数名词复数)
